meta.description: Narragansett movers with storage built into the move: pickup, short or long term storage and delivery when your next home is ready. Free quote.

overview: Moving out of a Narragansett home before the next one is ready? We can pick everything up, keep it in storage and bring it back on the day you get the keys.
One company handles all three steps, so there is no second mover and no rented truck in the middle.
sellingPoints: Pickup, storage and delivery in one plan
Priced by the space your things fill

servicesBlock.h2: Narragansett Moves With Storage in the Middle
servicesBlock.intro: When dates don't line up, storage is usually what fills the gap. Beyond that, we handle residential moves, packing, furniture-only jobs and long distance moves to other states. Mix and match from the list below, and the manager will fold it all into one plan with one schedule.

whyChoose.h2: Reasons to Let One Crew Hold Your Narragansett Things

cards.title: Gap Between Leases
cards.text: If one lease ends before the next begins, the crew loads on move-out day and holds your things until the new place opens up.

cards.title: Closing Pushed Back
cards.text: Buyers and sellers both deal with dates that slip. Your belongings wait in storage while the paperwork catches up.

cards.title: Renovation Under Way
cards.text: Clearing rooms for a renovation? We take what's in the way and deliver it back once the work is done.

cards.title: Pay for the Space
cards.text: Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up, so holding a few rooms of furniture costs less than holding a full house.

faqHeading: Storage and Moving Questions From Narragansett

faq.q: Can you hold everything from my Narragansett home until the next place is ready?
faq.a: Yes. The crew picks up, keeps your things in storage and delivers on the date you choose, short term or long term.

faq.q: How much does storage cost with a Narragansett move?
faq.a: It depends on volume. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up, and your quote lists it next to the move itself.

faq.q: Do I need to rent a truck to get things out of storage?
faq.a: No. Our crew brings your belongings out of storage on our own truck and carries them into the new home.

faq.q: What should I tell you when I ask for a quote that includes storage?
faq.a: Your move-out date, your best guess at the move-in date and roughly what you own. If the second date is still uncertain, say so and we'll plan around it.

faq.q: Could my things go from storage to another state later?
faq.a: Yes. A long distance leg can follow the storage period. Long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate, worked out from your items and the distance.

faqClosing: More on storage terms and booking is on our FAQ page.

closing.h2: Line Up Your Narragansett Move and Storage
closing.body: Send the dates you know and the ones you don't yet. We'll build a plan that covers pickup, storage and delivery, with a price for each part.
